correctness.rationale: Every left ideal is represented by a subspace \(U\) with intersection \(M_U\cap M_W=M_{U+W}\). A self-contained hyperplane count proves the ordinary lower bound \(q+1\). For \(n\ge3\), the \(q+1\) lines in a fixed two-dimensional subspace give a dominating clique, yielding total domination \(q+1\); matching parity gives paired domination \(q+1\) for odd \(q\) and \(q+2\) for even \(q\). For \(n=2\), the graph is edgeless.
